content: Industry slot stacks separate declarative JSON math config (symbols, strips, paylines, feature weights) from presentation. Resolve spin server-side or in shared math module: sample stops, evaluate lines, resolve features, return result payload for animation. Common modules: reel sampler, payline evaluator, free-spins, hold-and-win respins, meters/collectors, pick games, gamble. Client-only demos still keep math pure and snapshot-driven so view animates a resolved outcome.
